texts.orig: 43. Notification and communication of breach
texts.text: 43. Notification and communication of breach

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (1) Where personal data has been accessed or acquired by an unauthorised person, and there is a real risk of harm to the data subject whose personal data has been subjected to the unauthorised access, a data controller shall-
texts.text: Where personal data has been accessed or acquired by an unauthorised person, and there is a real risk of harm to the data subject whose personal data has been subjected to the unauthorised access, a data controller shall-

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (a) notify the Data Commissioner without delay, within seventy-two hours of becoming aware of such breach; and
texts.text: (a) notify the Data Commissioner without delay, within seventy-two hours of becoming aware of such breach; and

texts.label: list_item

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: (a) description of the nature of the data breach;

texts.text: (b) description of the measures that the data controller or data processor intends to take or has taken to address the data breach;
